name: Bank Interest
Office Maintenance
source_format:
{
  "templateId": "premises-upkeep",
  "templateVersion": 1,
  "title": "Office Maintenance",
  "description_template": "{maintenance_head} – {premises} for {period_month} (paid to {vendor_name}).",
  "sections": [
    {
      "id": "detail",
      "type": "fields",
      "title": "Maintenance",
      "layout": "grid",
      "columns": 2,
      "fields": [
        {
          "key": "maintenance_head",
          "label": "Maintenance Head",
          "type": "select",
          "options": [
            "Building Maintenance",
            "Store Room Maintenance",
            "Garbage Collection",
            "Diesel (DG)",
            "AC & Equipment Service",
            "Housekeeping",
            "Office Consumables",
            "Other"
          ],
          "required": true
        },
        {
          "key": "premises",
          "label": "Premises",
          "type": "select",
          "options": [
            "Office",
            "Store Room",
            "Godown",
            "Branch Office",
            "Other"
          ],
          "required": true
        },
        {
          "key": "period_month",
          "label": "For the Month",
          "type": "date",
          "required": true
        },
        {
          "key": "vendor_name",
          "label": "Paid To",
          "type": "text",
          "required": true
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "proof",
      "type": "image_attachments",
      "title": "Proof",
      "columns": 2,
      "slots": [
        {
          "key": "bill",
          "label": "Bill / Receipt",
          "accept": "image/*,application/pdf",
          "maxSizeMb": 5,
          "maps_to": "invoice_attachment"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

source_format:
{
  "templateId": "telecom-bill",
  "templateVersion": 1,
  "title": "Internet & Mobile Bill",
  "description_template": "{service_provider} {service_type} – {account_or_number}, {period_from} to {period_to}.",
  "sections": [
    {
      "id": "detail",
      "type": "fields",
      "title": "Bill",
      "layout": "grid",
      "columns": 2,
      "fields": [
        {
          "key": "service_provider",
          "label": "Provider",
          "type": "select",
          "options": [
            "Airtel",
            "ACT Fibernet",
            "Jio",
            "BSNL",
            "Google Workspace",
            "Other"
          ],
          "required": true
        },
        {
          "key": "service_type",
          "label": "Service",
          "type": "select",
          "options": [
            "Broadband",
            "Postpaid Mobile",
            "SIM Recharge",
            "Workspace / SaaS Line",
            "Other"
          ],
          "required": true
        },
        {
          "key": "account_or_number",
          "label": "Account / Mobile No.",
          "type": "text",
          "required": true
        },
        {
          "key": "period_from",
          "label": "Billing Period From",
          "type": "date",
          "required": true
        },
        {
          "key": "period_to",
          "label": "Billing Period To",
          "type": "date",
          "required": true
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "proof",
      "type": "image_attachments",
      "title": "Proof",
      "columns": 2,
      "slots": [
        {
          "key": "bill",
          "label": "Bill",
          "accept": "image/*,application/pdf",
          "maxSizeMb": 5,
          "maps_to": "invoice_attachment"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
